maria: PTAL — I've addressed the parsing edge-case you flagged in PR #482. Added unit tests for the utf8/trailing-null case and an integration test that covers streamed tokens. Also bumped parser dep to 2.1.4 to pick up the fix. Can we pick a canary slot today? (CC @chris @leo)

chris: Thanks — quick Q: did you preserve old behaviour behind a flag or is it a pure fix?

maria: Pure fix — backward compatible. There's a short migration note in the PR description. I left the old decoder handling as a separate function in case we want a rollback test.

leo: Eyeballing the diff now. If CI passes I'm fine with one more +1. Will wait for jen to sanity-check rollout timing.

jen: I'm out this afternoon but can approve for a small canary if deploy is before 4pm PST. Otherwise schedule for tomorrow morning. Also can you paste the smoke test command here?

maria: Smoke command pasted:
```
./scripts/smoke_run --model local-bert --input tests/fixtures/utf8-trailing-null.txt --timeout 30
```
CI job: https://ci.internal/runs/482

jen: lgtm for canary before 4pm PST. @deploy-bot can you schedule canary window? :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for PR #482 on host pool 'dedicated-gpu-3' at 2026-03-17T21:30:00Z; notify: @jen @chris @maria

maria: Thanks — I'll squash the trivial test commits into one and re-request final review; PTAL when you get a minute. :pray:
